A '''catchment arc''' was a part of the [[Ssi-ruu]]k's [[entechment rig]]. It created a powerful [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]] which charged the [[magsol]] and drained the subject's life energy, which was then forced out of the body for storage in [[battery coil]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
